projects.title: Let It Ride
projects.description: Let It Ride is an Android application developed by myself and Samual Sudar that allows users to place and track "bets" on sporting events.  Users can try to earn the most money by betting against the spread, straight up, or on the over/under of actual events. There is no real money involved, as this is a "fantasy betting" application.  Current release only supports College Football with future releases to support more sports.
